morning.caption:
US stocks fell for a sixth straight day on Thursday. The Dow lost 1,101 points, or 2.19%, the S&P 500 2.02% and the Nasdaq 2.25%, and all 11 sectors fell. AMD dropped 7.72% after a short report. Futures were lower again early Friday.

evening.caption:
Trump said Thursday he is "not rushing" into new strikes on Iran and will revisit it after the new year. Brent traded at $92.22 on Friday, heading for a third weekly drop. Houthi strikes damaged the PIF Tower in Riyadh, with no injuries reported. Our read, labeled as judgment: a 25% chance Brent tops $100 in 30 days. More at fiopoin.com
